description: This file defines a static class 'ConfigureCoreServices' with a method to register core services and dependencies into an IServiceCollection for dependency injection in an ASP.NET Core application. It configures repositories, services, query services, logging, and email sender.

classes.name: ConfigureCoreServices
classes.description: A static class providing an extension method for IServiceCollection to add core application services.

methods.name: AddCoreServices
methods.description: An extension method that registers core application services, repositories, query services, logging, and email sender into the dependency injection container.
